intro: True Food Kitchen is the health-focused, seasonal restaurant chain built on an anti-inflammatory philosophy, with a menu of grain bowls, sourdough pizzas, grass-fed and plant-based burgers, big salads, and fresh-pressed wellness juices and refreshers. It leans vegetarian- and vegan-friendly while keeping meat and seafood options. Below is the full True Food Kitchen menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At True Food Kitchen, signature bowls run about $21.55 to $22.05 (Ancient Grains $22.05, Teriyaki Quinoa and Korean Noodle $21.55), sourdough pizzas $20.35 to $23.70, and burgers $22.65 to $23.95. Salads are $16.50 to $29.25, and wellness juices like the Kale Aid are $11.70. It is an upscale-casual healthy restaurant, so prices are higher than fast food.
hot_deal: True Food Kitchen value: the Organic Tuscan Kale Salad ($16.50) and the Simple Green Salad ($17.10) are the lightest spend, and the spritzers ($6.00) are far cheaper than the fresh-pressed juices ($11.70). Happy hour at many locations drops prices on small plates and drinks. It is upscale-casual, so there is no value menu. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is a bowl at True Food Kitchen?
faqs.a: Signature bowls run about $21.55 to $22.05 (the Ancient Grains Bowl is $22.05), with the premium tuna poke bowl at $29.79. Sourdough pizzas are $20.35 to $23.70 and burgers $22.65 to $23.95. It is an upscale-casual healthy restaurant, so prices are higher than fast food.

faqs.q: What is True Food Kitchen known for?
faqs.a: True Food Kitchen is known for its health-focused, seasonal menu built on an anti-inflammatory philosophy, with signature grain bowls like the Ancient Grains Bowl, sourdough pizzas, grass-fed and plant-based burgers, and fresh-pressed wellness juices such as the Kale Aid.

faqs.q: Is True Food Kitchen vegan and vegetarian friendly?
faqs.a: Yes. True Food Kitchen is strongly vegetarian- and vegan-friendly, with many plant-based dishes and a plant-based double cheeseburger, while still offering meat and seafood options. The menu clearly marks vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free items.

faqs.q: Does True Food Kitchen list calories?
faqs.a: True Food Kitchen publishes nutrition information in its restaurants and online, but item calories are not reproduced here and are left blank rather than guessed. The menu is health-focused, but totals vary with the dish, the protein and the add-ons.

faqs.q: What are the most popular dishes at True Food Kitchen?
faqs.a: Favorites include the Ancient Grains Bowl, the Teriyaki Quinoa Bowl, the Organic Tuscan Kale Salad, the grass-fed burger, and the Kale Aid juice.
